exposure: infantile laxative exposure (at least 7 days within the first 6 months of life)
cohort: Children identified from Taiwan's National Health Insurance Research Database, including 291 children exposed to laxatives in early life and 1164 matched reference children without laxative exposure.
finding: Early life laxative exposure was independently associated with an increased 5-year cumulative incidence of allergic disease development (49.81% vs 41.68%).
